rows.name: Text probe (validation)

Rating: the predicted rating a book card shows, reconstructed with item_means=goodreads, calibration=evidence, predictor=hybrid:production.

rows.name: Best match as displayed (author variety)
rows.description: The same model with the Recommendations page's display step: repeat authors nudged down (author_penalty=0.5). Diagnostic; not the model's score.

rows.name: Random
rows.description: Uniformly random unread books from the For you universe (seeded per user).

rows.name: Genre + popularity
rows.description: Popular books within the parent genres the user rates most (rating-weighted genre share x within-genre popularity).

rows.name: Description similarity
rows.description: Content only: unread books ranked by cosine between their description embedding and the user's rating-weighted taste vector (s12).

rows.name: Description similarity + popularity
rows.description: The same, plus 0.1 x standardized log popularity.
